channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Cocaine offenders on pace to hit record number in Tokyo
item.description: In recent years, authorities have become increasingly concerned about the spread of cocaine among teenagers and people in their 20s.

item.title: Raising neurodivergent kids in Japan’s international homes
item.description: On-time trains and rigid rules are perfect for autistic children, but navigating support systems as a foreign parent can be another matter.

item.title: Main hall of Okinawa’s Shuri Castle unveiled to media
item.description: The hall will be open to the public from Nov. 23 after a completion ceremony hosted by the government.

item.title: ‘Zero’ break time: Fukuoka union uncovers strain put on teachers’ work
item.description: While Japan's labor laws require employers to provide breaks, time sheets show most public junior high school teachers in the city aren't taking one.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
